anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.
pass_a_gloss: But if [gap] the Savior to have been crucified [gap] as we have said before, the passion not being a type, the pascha, but a type of Christ himself —
pass_b_english: But if [lacuna] the Savior to have been crucified [lacuna] as we have said before, that the Passover is not a type of the passion but a type [of Christ himself] —
source_text: Εἰ δὲ ... αλλει δ[ι]ὰ τ[ὸ] τοὺς ... βαλλει ... οντας ... το ἐσ[τ(αυ)ρ(ῶσθ)αι] τὸν σ[(ωτῆ)ρα ... ]ισθαι του ... ιατο ρι ... τὸ λε ... σηλ[ ... ὡς] [π]ρ[ο]ειρήκα[μεν τοῦ πά]θους μ[ὴ τύ]πον εἶν[αι τὸ πάσχα ἀ]λ[λὰ] τύπον [αὐτοῦ τοῦ Χ(ριστο)ῦ] –
